Apply for Software Engineer 1

Root Source is seeking a Software Engineer 1 who will develop and sustain integrated, feature-rich capabilities that promote modernization of visualization and presentation tools. The software development team will provide application development and support to tools that allow mission analytic users to view existing data or contribute new information in a collaborative environment.

About Join our team at Root Source!

Thank you for taking the time to explore opportunities with Root Source.

Please review our job postings and submit your application for any positions of interest.

Root Source is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

Description

Responsibilities:

Develop and sustain integrated capabilities for visualization and presentation tools
Provide application development and support for mission analytic users

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related discipline
Seven years of SWE experience in similar programs and contracts
US Citizenship
Active TS/SCI with Poly

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

Java, Python, testing, source code control, IDE, Maven, Spring Boot, Django
Familiarity with analytical development, virtualization environments, streaming frameworks, and databases
Experience using ElasticSearch
Analyze user requirements, debug software, design and code new features, integrate software, write documentation, and more.

Hybrid telecommute available for this position.
